test_case.title: Non-admin mixed batch cannot reach persistence
test_case.objective: Verify authorization rejects a non-admin before a mixed-validity batch can create any partial product state.

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin/user fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Non-admin JWT with one valid and one invalid product

test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Non-admin is not authorized to import regardless of row composition.
test_case.expected_state: No row from the batch is persisted.
test_case.why_ai_missed: The AI tested non-admin authorization and mixed-batch atomicity separately, but not precedence of authorization over a batch that could expose partial processing.

test_case.title: Role-tampering payload with invalid batch
test_case.objective: Verify body role=admin cannot elevate a user JWT even when the batch itself contains validation errors.

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin/user fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: JWT user, body role=admin, products contain valid and zero-price rows

test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Role must come from the verified token; payload role and row errors cannot authorize import.
test_case.expected_state: No product is persisted and no partial validation-side effect is allowed.
test_case.why_ai_missed: The AI tested role tampering only with a valid products body and did not combine authorization bypass input with atomicity-sensitive invalid rows.

test_case.title: Injection-like name plus invalid-price rollback
test_case.objective: Verify an injection-like non-empty name remains data, while a separate invalid price causes the entire admin batch to roll back.

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin/user fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Row 1 has injection-like non-empty name and positive price; row 2 has valid name and price=0

test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: The injection-like name must not execute as a command; price=0 is invalid and triggers all-or-nothing rollback.
test_case.expected_state: Neither row is persisted and unrelated database state remains intact.
test_case.why_ai_missed: The AI covered injection input and invalid-row rollback separately, missing their combined transaction/security path.

student_cases.difference_from_ai_generated_suite: Combines parameterized-input resilience with a direct FR-16 validation error and atomic rollback.
student_cases.why_ai_missed: The AI covered injection input and invalid-row rollback separately, missing their combined transaction/security path.

test_case.title: Committed batch survives later invalid import rollback
test_case.objective: Verify atomic rollback is scoped to the current import and does not undo products committed by an earlier valid import.

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin/user fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Import valid batch A, then import batch B containing an invalid row

test_data.description: Distinct product identifiers for A and B
test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Batch A commits fully; batch B fails atomically because of its invalid row.
test_case.expected_state: Products from A remain; no product from B is persisted.
test_case.why_ai_missed: The AI tested rollback then corrected retry, but not the opposite sequence where a later rollback must preserve an earlier committed transaction.

student_cases.difference_from_ai_generated_suite: Reverses the sequence and checks transaction scope across two imports, not merely within one batch.
student_cases.why_ai_missed: The AI tested rollback then corrected retry, but not the opposite sequence where a later rollback must preserve an earlier committed transaction.

test_case.title: Two distinct row errors correlate with report and rollback
test_case.objective: Verify a batch with two different invalid rows reports both semantic reasons/counts while committing none of the valid middle row.

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin/user fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Empty-name row, valid middle row, negative-price row

test_data.description: Three rows with two distinct FR-16 violations
test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Report semantics reflect two errors and their reasons; any row error requires entire-batch rollback. Exact JSON keys remain unspecified.
test_case.expected_state: No row from the batch is persisted.

test_case.title: Prior admin commit survives later non-admin mixed batch
test_case.objective: Verify a later non-admin mixed-batch attempt cannot roll back an earlier authorized commit or partially persist any attempted row.
preconditions: Admin and non-admin JWT fixtures exist
Batch A and batch B use distinct product identifiers

request.auth_profile: Bearer admin JWT for step 1 and Bearer non-admin JWT for step 2
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Admin imports valid batch A successfully; then a non-admin submits batch B containing one valid row and one zero-price row

test_data.description: Valid multi-row batch A; batch B has one positive-price row and one price=0 row
test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Batch A commits under the admin request; the non-admin request cannot import batch B regardless of its mixed row validity.
test_case.expected_state: Every product from batch A remains; no product from batch B is persisted; pre-existing unrelated products remain unchanged.
test_case.why_ai_missed: Raw AI generation separated admin/non-admin authorization, atomic mixed-batch rollback, and cross-request transaction scope, so it did not test whether a later unauthorized request can corrupt a previously committed authorized state.

student_cases.difference_from_ai_generated_suite: Existing cases cover a non-admin mixed batch with no prior commit and an admin valid-then-invalid sequence with no principal change; none verifies cross-principal transaction isolation across an authorized commit followed by an unauthorized mixed-batch attempt.
student_cases.why_ai_missed: Raw AI generation separated admin/non-admin authorization, atomic mixed-batch rollback, and cross-request transaction scope, so it did not test whether a later unauthorized request can corrupt a previously committed authorized state.
